text:
Maya: quick heads-up  new cohort interviewers didn't get the v4 training bundle link in their onboarding packet. noticed during first debriefs.

Emma (People Ops): ack. any sample user or interview id we can look at?

Maya: user_992 and interview int_a77 are examples. recruiter screenshot attached showing "No materials found".

Webhook Bot: event=onboard.created id=user_992 status=200 payload.tags=["interviewer_v4"]

Sam - Recruiting Ops: i pulled the onboarding export and see tag present, but our L&D sync expects tag interviewer-v4 (hyphen). looks like a normalization difference in the ATS import, underscores vs hyphens.

Leo - Eng: that lines up with a recent enrichment change where we replace non-alphanum with underscores. i'll revert that behavior for known training tags and add a whitelist.

Emma (People Ops): priority is to get materials to these people today. Sam, can recruiting resend the bundle manually? we don't want to delay debriefs.

Sam - Recruiting Ops: yes. i can bulk resend. how should we assign scorecards for interviews that already happened? fallback to v3?

Maya: prefer not to change completed interviews. for future ones, set mapping interviewer-v4 -> training_bundle_v4 and assign scorecard v4. for the missed ones, resend materials and mark "training resent" in the candidate notes.

Leo - Eng: staging fix ready. sample fix: change enrichment rule to preserve hyphens for tags in the list ["interviewer-v4", "mentor-v2"]. adding unit test.

Sam - Recruiting Ops: resend job queued job-2245. i'll notify the cohort once completed.

Leo - Eng: prod deploy 2024-11-15T14:12Z succeeded. opened ticket ENG-7120 to add integration tests and a runbook entry for training-tag mismatches.

Emma (People Ops): i'll add a short Hiring Ops checklist for "missing training materials" with the resend command and tag mappings. also adding a recruiter-facing FAQ explaining underscore vs hyphen issues.

Maya: thanks all. i'll confirm with the cohort after they receive materials and close the loop. :white_check_mark:
